name: Pacific Vault Signal
description: The Coordinator has been intercepting fragments of a Vault-Tec signal from somewhere in the Pacific. It matches no known vault coordinates. She needs someone to triangulate the source by physically visiting three Pacific island waypoints.

stages.name: Visit Waypoint One — Marshall Islands
stages.description: The first triangulation point is in the Marshall Islands region. The Coordinator's signal analysis puts a strong source bearing from this location.

stages.name: Visit Waypoint Two — Federated States of Micronesia
stages.description: The second triangulation point. Cross-referencing with the first reading will narrow the source coordinates significantly.

stages.name: Visit Waypoint Three and Locate Source
stages.description: The third and final triangulation point. With all three readings, the Coordinator can pinpoint the vault signal source.
